d:
Haidrabad ki phemas baghare baingan ki yah paranprik aur behad svadisht sabji, bina lahsun pyaj ke. kisi bhi khas mauke ya tyohar ke lie bilkul parphekt. yah Easy & Tasty Bagara Baingan Recipe roti, parathe, puri, nan aur chaval sabhi ke sath svadisht lagti hai. paranprik khas masalon se bani grevi men lipte baingan ki Baingan Masala,ya Brinjal Curry pasand hai, to yah resipi jarur traee karen.
Ingredients for No Onion Garlic Bagara Baingan
Mungaphli - Peanuts - 4 tbsp
Til - Sesame - 2 tbsp
Khas khas - Poppy seeds - 1 tbsp
Sukha nariyal - Dessicated coconut - 4 tbsp
